chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 126: Ji Ning's Desperate Failure & The Ji Clan's Sacrificial Battle Order
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning's attack is shattered by the Flood Dragon Formation. Wounded and tracked, he is forced to watch as his clan organizes a suicidal relay of death to buy him time.
og_title: The Ji Clan Lines Up to Die
og_description: Ji Ning is struck by a tracking needle and forced to retreat as the Ji Clan elders organize a suicide relay to stall the enemy formation.
twitter_description: Wounded and overpowered, Ji Ning watches his family organize their own funerals in a desperate battle order.
